modpacks.name: Gen 3-9 Complete Expansion
modpacks.author: HyruleChosenOne
modpacks.tagline: Gen 3-9 Characters + Gen 3-9 Stages bundled together in 1 click.
modpacks.description: Installs and enables both National Dex Gen 3-9 (Hoenn through Paldea playable Pokemon with full PMD animations, 11-language translations, 72 signature moves, classic & alternate shiny variants) and Gen 3-9 Regions & Levels Pack (14 custom stages across 7 regions with unique 3D terrain geometry, bespoke pixel-art textures, 14 official region-matched stage soundtracks, and 3D landmarks) together.

modpacks.name: Classic Gen 1&2 Audio Collection
modpacks.author: HyruleChosenOne
modpacks.tagline: Gen 1&2 Soundtrack (53 FRLG/HGSS tracks covering all events) + Classic Sound Effects (45 FRLG/GBA SFX) bundled together.
modpacks.description: Complete classic Pokemon audio overhaul combining Gen 1&2 Soundtrack (covering every PokéBonk menu, seasonal event, battle, dungeon, and boss theme from FireRed/LeafGreen & HeartGold/SoulSilver) with Classic Sound Effects (authentic FRLG menu/milestone fanfares and GBA elemental combat attack SFX). 100% Client-side and Co-op safe.
